title: Vampire Vape Hazelnut Latte Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Indulge in the velvety warmth of Vampire Vape’s Hazelnut Latte e-liquid, a sumptuous blend that combines the richness of freshly brewed coffee with the irresistible taste of roasted hazelnuts. This luxurious concoction perfectly captures the essence of a comforting coffeehouse favourite, providing a truly satisfying vaping experience. Savour the aromatic harmony of robust coffee notes and the nutty decadence of hazelnuts as they interweave to create a smooth and well-rounded flavour profile. Ideal for coffee enthusiasts and those seeking a touch of indulgence, Hazelnut Latte offers a moment of pure comfort and bliss with every puff. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
